lead.headline: Oklahoma refineries pay $3,300 in air penalties per logged violation; Texas refineries pay $142,000
lead.number: Refinery-coded sites 2015-25: Oklahoma 9 sites, 148 violations, $0.48M penalties ($3.3K each); Texas 58 sites, 203 violations, $28.8M ($142K each).
lead.watch_out: Only 9 facilities, and states differ in what they report into this federal file.
